name: lantern-agent
description: A private coding agent that asks before it acts. Paste your keys once and Spark builds a relay chain of free tiers (Cerebras, Groq, Gemini, OpenRouter, SambaNova, Mistral) with automatic failover; carry it anywhere with an encrypted Lantern Pass. Streaming, diff previews, chat history, /undo, and a fully local mode via Ollama. Zero dependencies.
author: JAMMx2
